title: Skyscrapers and Sunrises: What City and Country Living Really Do to Us
title_zh: 摩天大楼与日出：城市与乡村生活究竟带给我们什么
intro_zh: 本文约900词，是一篇适合CET-4水平的对比说明文，探讨城市与乡村生活的利弊与平衡。

paragraphs.en: The choice between city life and country life is not simply a matter of location. It reflects our values, needs, and dreams. In a city, skyscrapers pierce the sky, and the streets are never empty. In the countryside, open fields stretch as far as the eye can see, and the only sounds at night may be the wind and the crickets. Both worlds have their strong supporters. Some people say they could not live without the energy of a city, while others claim that true peace is only found in nature. Which one is really better? Let us look at the facts and stories behind both lifestyles.
paragraphs.zh: 城市生活与乡村生活之间的选择，不仅仅是一个地理位置的问题。它反映了我们的价值观、需求和梦想。在城市中，摩天大楼直插云霄，街道永远不会空荡。在乡村，开阔的田野一望无际，夜晚唯一的声音可能只是风声和蟋蟀鸣叫。这两种世界都有坚定的支持者。有人说他们离不开城市的活力，也有人声称真正的宁静只有在自然中才能找到。究竟哪一种更好？让我们看看这两种生活方式背后的事实与故事。

paragraphs.en: For many, city life is attractive because of its sheer convenience. Everything you need is within reach: restaurants, shopping malls, hospitals, and cultural amenities. A well-developed public transport system means that you can go from one end of a city to another without owning a car. Young professionals also benefit from abundant job opportunities, as businesses and industries usually gather in urban centers. However, this convenience comes with hidden costs. Dense populations create heavy traffic, high housing prices, and high levels of noise. The very things that make cities exciting, like the crowds and constant movement, can also lead to stress and exhaustion.
paragraphs.zh: 对许多人来说，城市生活的吸引力在于其极其便利。你所需的一切都在附近：餐馆、购物中心、医院和文化设施。发达的公共交通系统意味着没有车也能从城市的一端到另一端。年轻的专业人士也能得益于大量的工作机会，因为企业和产业通常集中在市中心。然而，这种便利伴随着隐性成本。密集的人口带来严重的交通拥堵、高昂的房价和高分贝的噪音。那些让城市令人兴奋的东西——人群和不断的流动——也可能导致压力和疲惫。

paragraphs.en: The countryside offers a completely different experience. The air is fresher, the landscape is greener, and the pace of life is slower. Many rural communities still have a strong sense of togetherness, where neighbors know each other by name and often help one another in times of need. For children, growing up in the countryside can mean more space to play and a closer connection to animals and plants. But rural life is not perfect. Lack of quality schools, medical services, and shopping options often forces young people to move to cities. Moreover, the quiet of the countryside can turn into isolation if you have no transportation and few chances to meet people. Even so, the serenity of rural life remains a powerful draw for those who are tired of urban noise.
paragraphs.zh: 乡村则带来完全不同的体验。空气更清新，景色更翠绿，生活节奏更慢。许多农村社区仍有很强的集体感，邻居之间彼此知道姓名，常常在需要时互相帮助。对孩子来说，在乡下长大可能意味着有更多玩耍的空间，能与动植物更亲近。但乡村生活并不完美。缺乏优质学校、医疗服务和购物选择常常迫使年轻人流向城市。而且，如果交通不便、人际交往机会少，乡村的安静也可能变成与世隔绝。即便如此，乡村生活的宁静仍然对那些厌倦城市噪音的人有巨大吸引力。

paragraphs.en: Science has begun to explain why nature has a calming effect. Studies in environmental psychology show that contact with natural settings can reduce stress and improve attention. One famous experiment asked participants to take a walk in either a city area or a green park. After the walk, the park walkers displayed better moods and lower mental fatigue. In contrast, the city walkers experienced no improvement. These findings suggest that our brains need restful environments. Urban environments, full of signs, traffic lights, and people, require constant attention, which can be mentally draining. Therefore, even a short break in a garden or park can help city dwellers restore their mental energy.
paragraphs.zh: 科学已经开始解释为什么大自然有镇静作用。环境心理学研究发现，接触自然环境可以减轻压力、提高注意力。一个著名的实验让参与者要么在城市街道散步，要么在绿色公园散步。散步后，公园散步者情绪更好，心理疲劳也更低。相比之下，城市散步者没有改善。这些发现表明，我们的大脑需要能让人休息的环境。充满招牌、红绿灯和人群的城市环境，要求我们持续注意，这会消耗精神。因此，即使只在花园或公园里短暂休息，也能帮助城市居民恢复精神能量。

paragraphs.en: Another key factor is how we use our time. Surveys show that people in large cities spend an average of one hour or more every day on the commute to and from work. This long commute eats into personal and family time, and may increase anxiety. In rural areas, the majority of people work close to home or on farms, so they save that time for leisure or hobbies. However, rural residents sometimes need to travel far for specialized services, especially health care. In this sense, the 'slow' life in the countryside may still involve long-distance travel, but usually only on certain days. When we think about city versus country, it is essential to compare not just the scenery, but also the real daily schedules.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个关键因素是时间的使用方式。调查显示，大城市居民每天平均花费一小时或更长时间在上下班的通勤上。漫长的通勤挤占了个人和家庭时间，可能加剧焦虑。在乡村，多数人在家附近工作或从事农业，省下的时间用于休闲或爱好。然而，乡村居民有时需要走很远才能获得专业服务，尤其是医疗。从这个意义上说，乡村的‘慢’生活也许依然包含长距离出行，但通常只是固定的日子。当我们思考城市与乡村时，不能只看风景，还要比较真实的日常安排。

paragraphs.en: Fortunately, we do not have to make an all-or-nothing choice. Many modern cities are trying to bring nature back. They build rooftop gardens, add more parks, and protect green corridors. At the same time, rural areas benefit from better roads and digital networks, which attract people who can work remotely. This creates a new possibility, the integration of city opportunities and rural peace. For example, a graphic designer living in a village can serve clients in a big city online. He or she enjoys fresh air in the morning and still has access to a vibrant job market in the afternoon.
paragraphs.zh: 幸运的是，我们不必做出二选一的决定。许多现代城市正努力把自然带回人们身边。他们建造屋顶花园，增设公园，保护绿色走廊。同时，乡村地区也因更好的道路和网络基础设施而受益，这吸引了那些可以远程工作的人。这创造了一种新的可能——城市机遇与乡村宁静的融合。例如，住在村庄的平面设计师可以线上服务大城市的客户。他或她早上享受新鲜空气，下午依然能接触到充满活力的就业市场。

paragraphs.en: Take the case of Li Ming, who grew up in Beijing but moved to a small town in Yunnan two years ago. He had been tired of crowded subways and endless meetings. Now he works as a freelance writer from his small house near a lake. Li Ming walks in the forest every day and says that his creative thinking has improved greatly. Of course, he sometimes misses the late-night cafes and museum exhibitions. Yet he can also visit Beijing twice a year, and his internet connection is surprisingly fast. Li Ming has found a balance that makes sense for him. His story shows that geographical location is no longer a fixed fate; it has become a personal decision.
paragraphs.zh: 以李明为例，他在北京长大，两年前搬到了云南的一个小镇。他早就厌倦了拥挤的地铁和无休止的会议。现在他是一名自由撰稿人，住在湖边的小房子里。李明每天在森林里散步，他说自己的创造性思维得到了很大提升。当然，他有时会想念深夜咖啡馆和博物馆展览。但他每年仍可进京两次，而且他的网络速度快得惊人。李明找到了适合自己的平衡。他的故事表明，地理位置不再是固定的命运，而是一个个人决定。

paragraphs.en: In the end, the real question is not whether the city or the country is better. It is about what we want from life. Some people crave the energy and stimulation of a city; others value the quiet and solitude of the countryside. Both choices have strengths and weaknesses. Understanding your own personality and priorities is the key. Perhaps the wisest view is to see the two not as enemies but as two sides of the same coin—different tools for different seasons of our lives. No matter where you live, you can create your own rhythm, and you can always visit the other world to explore what it has to offer.
paragraphs.zh: 归根结底，真正的问题不是城市还是乡村更好，而是我们想要从生活中获得什么。有些人渴望城市的能量和刺激；另一些人珍视乡间的宁静和独处。两种选择都有其长处和短处。了解自己的个性和优先级是关键。或许最智慧的看法是把这两者看成硬币的两面而非对手——适合我们生命不同阶段的不同工具。无论你住在哪里，你都可以创建自己的节奏，也随时可以去另一个世界体验那里能提供的东西。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: A. To persuade people to move from cities to rural areas.
B. To discuss the relative advantages and disadvantages of urban and rural life.
C. To argue that city life is more convenient than rural life.
D. To describe the latest trends in remote working.
questions.explain: 主旨题。文章没有劝说任何一方，而是客观比较两者的优缺点，并指出选择取决于个人需求，因此B正确。

questions.q: According to the experiment in paragraph 4, what happened after the walks?
options: A. City walkers became more stressed.
B. Park walkers felt happier and less tired mentally.
C. Park walkers had no significant change.
D. City walkers showed lower level of fatigue.
questions.explain: 细节题。第四段明确提到“park walkers displayed better moods and lower mental fatigue”，即公园散步者情绪更好、心理疲劳更低，所以选B。

questions.q: The example of Li Ming is mentioned to show that ______.
options: A. internet in rural areas is faster than in cities
B. remote work makes it possible to combine the benefits of city and countryside
C. moving to the countryside is popular among freelancers
D. people should leave big cities to improve creativity
questions.explain: 推断题。李明的例子说明由于网络技术，他可以在乡村生活的同时继续从事面向城市的工作，体现了城市与乡村优势的结合，所以B正确。

questions.q: The word "solitude" in the last paragraph is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 词义题。solitude 意为“独处”，强调一种中性甚至正面的独自状态，而 loneliness 通常带有孤独、难过的负面色彩，因此A最接近。
